The '''Garqi refugee camp''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] refugee camp located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The camp was located approximately twenty kilometers from one of the sites of conflict in the [[Battle of Garqi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Garqi]].

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Traavis]] presided over the fortified camp, which was constructed in a grassy valley surrounded by cliffs on three sides. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]], many Garqi citizens, and several [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] creatures occupied the camp.

Following the accidental bombing of a [[Garqian]] farmhouse, Traavis dispatched [[Aiwha Squad]] to search for any survivors. The squad, led by [[Sarge (clone commando)|Sarge]], discovered an orphaned boy named [[Evan]] and proceeded to bring him back to the refugee camp. After delivering the young farmer to General Traavis, Aiwha Squad received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and executed Traavis in the middle of the camp while Evan watched.<ref name="Orders comic">{{CWACite|4|Orders (comic story)}}</ref>
